name: infrastructure
description: Semantic dictionary defining infrastructure ontology terms, fields, and relationships.

object.label: Infrastructure Object
object.description: A generic parent term for any infrastructure, identity, application, network, data, security boundary, or platform object represented in the graph.

account.label: Account
account.description: A cloud, SaaS, or platform account that owns or contains infrastructure resources.

region.label: Region
region.description: A geographic or logical provider region, zone, site, or locality.

subnet.label: Subnet
subnet.description: A segmented network range inside a network.

compute.label: Compute
compute.description: A runtime capable of executing workloads.

function.label: Function
function.description: A serverless compute function or event-driven execution unit.

application.label: Application
application.description: A logical grouping of infrastructure, services, identities, and data resources that collectively deliver a business capability.

api.label: API
api.description: A network-accessible application interface, endpoint, gateway, ingress, or load-balanced interface.

datastore.label: Data Store
datastore.description: A structured or semi-structured data persistence system.

identity_provider.label: Identity Provider
identity_provider.description: A system that authenticates users, applications, services, or identities.

group.label: Group
group.description: A collection of users or identities.

role.label: Role
role.description: An assumable identity used by users, services, or workloads.

policy.label: Policy
policy.description: A permission document, rule set, access control policy, or governance policy.

secret.label: Secret
secret.description: Sensitive credential, key, token, or configuration material.

dns_record.label: DNS Record
dns_record.description: A DNS record that routes names to targets.

certificate.label: Certificate
certificate.description: A TLS, signing, or identity certificate.

security_boundary.label: Security Boundary
security_boundary.description: A network, identity, or access-control boundary.

queue.label: Queue
queue.description: An asynchronous messaging, event, topic, bus, or queue resource.

deployed_in.label: Deployed In
deployed_in.description: Runtime or resource placement inside another infrastructure object.

hosts.label: Hosts
hosts.description: Reverse placement relationship indicating that an object hosts another runtime or resource.

uses.label: Uses
uses.description: Generic dependency or operational use relationship.

used_by.label: Used By
used_by.description: Reverse generic dependency or usage relationship.

invokes.label: Invokes
invokes.description: Execution, request flow, trigger, or call relationship.

reads.label: Reads
reads.description: Read access to data or stored objects.

writes.label: Writes
writes.description: Write access to data, stored objects, queues, topics, or event targets.

grants.label: Grants
grants.description: Permission granted by a policy, role, group, ACL, or access rule.

attached_to.label: Attached To
attached_to.description: Attachment between an infrastructure object and another object.

authenticates.label: Authenticates
authenticates.description: Authentication relationship between an identity provider and an identity or application.

routes_to.label: Routes To
routes_to.description: Network, DNS, endpoint, gateway, or request routing relationship.

protects.label: Protects
protects.description: Protection relationship from a security boundary, certificate, secret, key, or control to another infrastructure object.

trusts.label: Trusts
trusts.description: Trust relationship between identities, systems, accounts, providers, or applications.
